mapper.select: SELECT id, image_name, image_path, title, subtitle, price, link_url, sort_order, status, create_time, update_time FROM banner ORDER BY sort_order ASC, create_time DESC
SELECT id, image_name, image_path, title, subtitle, price, link_url, sort_order, status, create_time, update_time FROM banner WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO banner ( image_name, image_path, title, subtitle, price, link_url, sort_order, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{imageName}, #{imagePath}, #{title}, #{subtitle}, #{price}, #{linkUrl}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE banner SET image_name = #{imageName}, image_path = #{imagePath}, title = #{title}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, price = #{price}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE banner SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE banner SET sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
